findings.title: findMany removed without replacement for existing callers
findings.body: The public `findMany` method was removed and replaced by `getBaseConditions` returning raw SQL. Any existing caller of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` (e.g. insights tRPC routers) will break at compile time, or need rewriting to `$queryRaw`. The PR does not update any callers.

findings.title: Caching tests deleted
findings.body: The tests that verified authorization and filter conditions are cached were removed instead of being ported to the Prisma.sql format. The caching behavior is still present in the service but is now untested.

findings.title: Loosened constructor type allows invalid options silently
findings.body: The constructor now accepts `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions`, in which `teamId` is optional for every scope. A caller passing `scope: "team"` without `teamId` now compiles. Validation then fails silently and the service returns `1=0` (no data), where this mistake used to be a type error.
